◇ Renewal Celebration Missions
※ Event Period until: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)

1-3. Balance Adjustments!

The performance of "Annerose Vajra" has been adjusted as follows:

- The visual effects, animations, area of effect, and damage of some skills have changed.
- A new unique skill has been added.
└ Yaksha's Wrath: Each time a skill is used, you gain 1 stack of Yaksha's Wrath. (stacks up to 3) Using a skill when Yaksha's Wrath is on a full stack depletes the gauge and activates Yaksha Unbound.
- The delay before and after using the skill "Yaksha Itto Style" has been reduced.
- The delay before and after using the skill "Madousen" has been reduced, and its basic effect and slot effects have been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Slashes enemies with enlarged blade and deals an area attack. ▶ Thrusts forward with an enlarged blade dealing an area attack ahead, restoring HP equal to 3% of the damage dealt.
└ 2 Assist-Type Supporters: Add area attack at the end of the skill and restore HP by 3% of damage dealt ▶ Increase speed by 10% for 10 seconds
└ 2 Suppress-Type Supporters: Stun the enemy ▶ Decrease enemy defense by 10% for 10 seconds
- The skill "Fleuretty's Grudge" has been fixed to enable attack by using the attack button while in counter-attack stance, and its basic effect and slot effect have been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Assuming a stance to counter-attack to hugely reduce incoming damage, and when hit, things come out of the trunk and counter-attack enemies. ▶ Assumes a counter stance, greatly reducing damage taken. When attacked, contents of the trunk burst out and deal a counterattack to the front. On a successful counter, gain 1 additional stack of Yaksha's Wrath.
└ 2 Protect-Type Supporters: Knock down the enemy ▶ Reduce enemy speed by 20% for 5 seconds
- The basic effect and slot effect for the skill "Yaksha Unbound" have been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Extreme Dodge activates the witch's sense that increases Crit. rate, damage, and defense for 4 seconds. ▶ Extreme Dodge activates the witch's sense, increasing critical rate, damage, and defense for 6 seconds.
└ 2 Assist-Type Supporters: Increase the duration by 2 seconds ▶ Additionally increase ATK by 10%
- The delay after using the skill "Devour" has been reduced, and its basic effect and slot effects have been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Whips black strands reaching out from the sword and restores HP by 3% of the damage dealt; Attack range increases when the skill slot is applied. ▶ Flail tendrils extending from the sword the deal an area attack, restoring HP equal to 3% of the damage dealt. Pulls enemies in when slot effect is applied.
└ 3 Protect-Type Supporters: Pull the enemy towards the character ▶ Pull an enemy towards the character and does an additional attack
└ 3 Suppress-Type Supporters: Stun the enemy ▶ Decrease enemy defense by 30% for 10 seconds
- The basic effect for the skill "Divine Wrath" has been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Teleports to the nearest enemy and performs a falling attack with dark lightning. ▶ Teleports behind the neareast enemy and performs a diving attack with black lightning, and creates a field of lightning on the attack spot that deals damage over time for 3 seconds.
- The delay before using the skill "Hyakuretsusen" has been reduced, and its slot effects have been changed.
└ 2 Assist-Type Supporters: Perform an additional attack that knocks back the enemy at the end of the skill ▶ Perform an additional attack at the end of the skill, making the enemy groggy
└ 3 Assist-Type Supporters: Increase critical rate by 50% ▶ Increase critical rate by 50%, reduce enemy speed by 40% for 7 seconds

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Improvements and Changes in Taima-Five VR
notes.content:
Greetings from the Action Taimanin Team.

Since its release, Taima-Five VR(hereafter VR) has served as a key piece of content to test your characters' growth and power.
However, as the game continues to expand with more diverse content, it came to our attention that VR has also become stale, and a source of fatigue for many players.

We will therefore implement the following changes to VR to improve your gameplay experience after the maintenance on June 3rd, 2025:

1. Partial Retention of Progress After Season Resets

Current: All progress resets; players restart from Step 1 after every season
After: Progress will now be saved in 10-step intervals (e.g.: If you finished the previous season on Step 65, you would begin the new season from Step 60.)

※ This system will be applied after the maintenance on June 3rd, 2025, so the actual implementation of the new system will take effect starting June 10th, 2025, at 03:00 (UTC).
※ As the previous season's record is partially saved, balance adjustments will be made to VR Bosses Queen Kanaloa, and Tenkyu #2.


2. Expansion of Step Unlock Based on Clear Time

Current: Clearing a Step unlocked up to 3 Steps.
After: You can now unlock up to 5 Steps based on your clear time.


3. VR Auto-Finish Feature Added

If a Step is cleared in the ongoing season, and the Step is cleared within 60 seconds, you can Auto-Finish the Step.
Auto-Finishing VR Steps consume BP and Operational Plans, and deployed characters will lose 10% HP per run.


Thank you.

notes.content:
Greetings from the Action Taimanin team.

We regret to inform you that we have received a notice regarding violations of the Google Play policy for certain costume series.

In accordance with Google Play's directive to remove certain costumes, the sale of several costumes and packages will be discontinued.

1. Affected Costume Series
 └ Nurse Call, Battle Scarred, A Gift Only For You, Slice of Life, Sleepover Ladies, Maid in Gosha, Bathrobe series, and more

2. Early Termination of In-Game Package Sales

 └ "Lightning Sonic" Package
 └ Weekly Limited Costume Pack
 └ Weekly Limited Costume Pack 2

※ Please note that packages apart from those mentioned above may also be discontinued early, and their contents may be replaced with alternative items.
We kindly ask for your understanding that certain content, such as the Collection may only be partially visible.
※ Costume packages (new or repeat) may not be released on AOS.
※ The above measures are scheduled to take effect after 02:00 (UTC) on May 6th, 2025.

These changes only apply to Android devices. There will be no impact on iOS devices, Steam, or STOVE, and functions such as purchasing and previewing will remain as normal.

We kindly ask for your understanding that this is an unavoidable step to ensure the continuation of Action Taimanin on Google Play, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We fully respect the advisory decisions made in accordance with Google Play's policy guidelines. Our team is dedicated to exploring various solutions and alternatives to ensure compliance with platform regulations and to provide a sustainable service moving forward.

We are also aware that many of you have suggested solutions such as raising the age rating, offering APK files, and expanding into various third-party Android markets.
Please rest assured that we are actively pursuing these options to ensure a stable experience for all players.

Once our plans are finalized, we will provide further details in a separate announcement.

As a gesture of appreciation for your understanding and support, we have prepared a small token for all Commanders.
Please input the following coupon code and check your Mailbox for your reward.

Coupon Code: MECV2JVQLV
Expiration Date: 2025-05-31

We truly appreciate your continued interest and support for Action Taimanin.
We remain committed to providing an enjoyable and exciting game experience for all of you.

Thank you.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Addressing the excessive update size on some devices
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Action Taimanin.

Action Taimanin strives every day to provide you with a better game service by collecting your opinions.

We have continuously optimized the size of the game through updates on December 3rd, 2024, and January 7th, 2025, but we have found that some commanders still have inconveniences with the update size depending on various devices.

Especially, when the data has been accumulated massively after installing the game for the first time, the app size may increase, causing problems with your device's capacity when updating the game. In this case, we recommend you uninstall the game completely and reinstall.

※ We advise you to issue a [Link Code] or link your account with a [Social Media Account] to keep your login information before you uninstall the game.

Also, we sincerely understand the inconvenience you are experiencing with the recently updated [Total War] content.
We are currently preparing methods based on your opinions to provide a better battle experience and QOL.

Thank you for your understanding and patience.

1-3. Balance Adjustments!

The performance of "Kousaka Shizuru" has been adjusted as follows:

- The visual effects, animations, area of effect, and damage of some skills have been changed.
- A new unique skill has been added.
└ Unique Skill: Bloom: Drops a rose that grants 1 out of the following 5 effects when an enemy marked with Seed Bomb is eliminated or the duration of Seed Bomb ends.
Rose effects: HP restoration, charge Particles, ATK increase, Speed increase, gain Super Armor
- The unique debuff for Shizuru has been changed.
Seed Bomb: Reduces speed, explodes after 3 seconds dealing area damage ▶ Reduces speed and DEF for 6 seconds, then explodes after 6 seconds, dealing area damage.
- The effect and slot effect of the skill, "Whip Shot", has been partially changed.
└ Basic effect: Performs an area attack by cracking her whip in circles. ▶ Swings a whip in a cone shape toward the front, delivering an area attack and inflicting Seed Bomb to enemies hit.
└ Protect Set Main: Plant a seed bomb on the target ▶ Reduce the speed of enemies hit by 10% for 10 seconds.
- The command for the skill, "Queen's Whip", has been changed.
- The effect of the skill, "Sprout Garden", has been changed.
└ Basic effect: When doing an extreme dodge, creates a field that reduces enemies' speed and restores HP over time. ▶ When doing an extreme dodge, slows enemies down, dropping 2 roses and deploys a healing field that restores HP over time.
- The effect and slot effect of the skill, "Plant Wall", has been partially changed.
└ Basic effect: Creates a wall of thorns that spins at the spot and continuously attacks the enemies. ▶ Creates a wall of moving thorns on the spot which perform continuous attacks. Enemies hit by them are inflicted with Seed Bomb.
└ Protect Set 2: Plant a seed bomb on the target ▶ Reduce the speed of enemies hit by 20% for 10 seconds.

notes.title: Introducing our new content, Total War
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38695850/599b1164fb83eea4caa16cababf1467b96959181.jpg[/img]

Coming on January 7th, 2025, the new boss raid "Total War" will be officially added!
Challenge against a boss with infinite health and claim your place on the leaderboard!

◇ Total War Season Start and Reset

    Total War seaons renew on every Tuesday at 03:00 (UTC) and preparation time for the new season is from 02:00 to 03:00 (UTC) on that day. Commanders can enter Total War if their commander rank is over 50, and have cleared Main Chapter 19. Total War has two modes, the "Normal Mode" and the "Relay Mode", and commanders can play either one of the modes, or both. When a new season starts, rewards will be given out following the commander's ranking on the leaderboard, and their scores and rankings resets.

◇ What is Total War?

    Total War battles are fully automated, and commanders can't control their characters. Characters die when their HP reaches 0, but the boss doesn't get killed even when their health drops below 50% or becomes 0, and recovers itself to a 100% HP automatically. (Doesn't apply to summoned monsters) The challenge ends when the time limit is over, or when all characters die.

◇ Total War Normal Mode

    In Normal Mode, commanders challenge the boss within a 3-minute time limit with a team of 3 characters, and all 3 characters must be assembled in order to start the challenge. Commanders can select Supporter Formations, but unlike Taima-Five VR, the preset feature won't be available (character presets are available).

Challenge Cost: Normal Mode challenge costs BP, and it is used when the challenge starts. Even if one forfeits, the used BP doesn't get returned. 
Attempts: Commanders can attempt to challenge 3 times a day in Normal Mode. Each attempt is used when the challenge starts like BP, and will NOT be returned even when forfeiting a battle. After using all 3 attempts every day, commanders can attempt additionally by using gems (resets at 15:00 UTC). Force-quitting during the Total War battle is considered the same as forfeit.
Score: The total damage dealt to the boss within a single battle is partially converted to the score. The top three scores within a season is only saved during that season, and the most recent score can be checked separately. Only the best score within a season goes on the leaderboard.

◇ Total War Relay Mode

    In Relay Mode, commanders challenge the boss with multiple teams of three, with 1-minute given per battle. The number of teams depends on how many characters you own, and can be assembled from the highest CP order, or with a balanced CP for all teams. Be advised that characters that already challenged the boss cannot be assembled again as a team (doesn't apply to supporters or weapons).

Challenge Cost: Relay Mode costs BP like Normal Mode, and it is used when the challenge starts. Even after forfeit, the used BP doesn't get returned. 
Attempts: Relay Mode doesn't have an attempt count, and you can challenge the boss consecutively by assembling teams of three matching the number of characters you have. By resetting Relay Mode, you can challenge again from the start. This also resets the score and character participation in battles (the score earned from the previous challenge is applied to the leaderboard, or can be checked separately). Reset doesn't cost anything.
Score: The total damage dealt to the boss with a single team is partially converted to the score, and the combination of all team scores is the final score. The top five scores of a season are only saved during that season and gets recorded on a separate leaderboard from the Normal Mode.
Consecutive Challenge: The consecutive challenge feature is exclusive to the Relay Mode, and it can be progressed by clicking on the 'Challenge Consecutively' button after assembling all the teams. During consecutive challenge, supporters and weapons already used cannot be equipped to others, and only one supporter formation is applied to all teams. If forfeiting during the consecutive challenge, you can continue starting from the team that forfeited. (Teams that already challenged the boss cannot challenge again)

◇ Total War Ranking

    After the challenge, you recieve a score that goes on the leaderboard, and your highest score is applied in real-time. Commanders from 1st place to 500th place will have their ranks based on their place on the leaderboard, and other commanders will be allocated in the score-based scale system, and recieve rewards.

◇ Total War Reward

    After a season resets, commanders will receive Total War rewards via mailbox following each commander's rank on the leaderboard upon entering the Total War page. The rewards must be collected within a week, and won't be available to collect after the next season starts. Mettle Coins will be given as normal rewards that can be used in the Mettle Shop, and the top 500 commanders will receive Honor Coins additionally, which can be used in the Honor Shop. Commander Marks or various upgrade materials can be traded in the Special Shop, and items in the Special Shop can be bought weekly, monthly, or once per account.

notes.title: 【New Content Update】 Club
notes.content:
On October 1st, 2024, the new "Club" guild system will be officially added!
Join a Club to receive Club-exclusive rewards and explore new content where you can cooperate with other commanders!


◇ Creating and Joining a Club

Only commanders with a rank of 30 or higher can create a Club, but anyone can join. However, if your in-game language differs from the Club’s main language, you may be restricted from joining. The Club Master can decide whether to allow/deny applications on the Club’s information page, and a Club can have up to 20 members.

Club Chatting: A communication tool for commanders in the same Club. You can chat with each other or check updates such as other members' rare item acquisitions or successful enchants. Members can individually set what information is shown in the chat.
Club Login: By logging in daily, commanders can receive a Club Login Bonus. In addition to the basic login bonus rewards, a special login bonus focused on items, gacha, and more will be offered at a low cost.
Club Buff: Clubs offer commanders various buffs that help in battles. Club Buffs are applied individually and can be upgraded with Club Buff Points which are given based on the number of characters each commander owns. Club Buffs can be stacked with existing Awaken Skills.
Club Party: The Club Master can activate a maximum of 2 buffs that apply to the entire Club for a certain amount of time.
Club Donation: By donating various materials, commanders can earn Club Points and Club Attribute Points. Club Attribute Points are tracked daily and reset anew every 15:00 (UTC), which is applied to the Club Rank in real-time.
Club Store: Use Club Points obtained from Club Donations to buy various items. As the Club Store level increases, so does the item variety. The paid Club Package is also available at the Club Store, and when one member purchases it, all other members receive additional presents.
Club Facilities: Use Club Attribute Points to upgrade facilities within the Club. Upgrading facilities will upgrade the Club Party, Club Store, and Club Donation levels while increasing the maximum level for Club Buffs available to members.
Club Pass: Earn Club Pass rewards by completing Club Pass missions, and unlock a special reward with a special reward key obtained from the Club Store, etc. The Club Pass mission progress reflects the combined efforts of all members. 

◇ Club Rank
Weekly/Monthly Club Ranks are tallied through a sum of Club Attribute Points gained from Club Daily Login and Club Donation. Be sure to participate in club activities to reach higher ranks.

◇ Club Quests
Club-exclusive battle content such as Club Raid will be added through future updates.
These contents will be designed to cooperate with other members to receive various items as rewards.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Two changes including balance adjustments
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Action Taimanin.

The following is the pre-notice for changes including supporter balance adjustments that will be applied after the scheduled maintenance on May 6th, 2024.


1. Supporter "[UR] Torajiro"

Before (stats are based on sLv. 1)

◇ Sub - Wild Blood
      When performing a melee attack, has a 15% chance to increase the duration of 2 buffs by 1 second
◇ Main - Weretiger's Roar
      Roar loudly and deal 440% damage to surrounding enemies, making them groggy. If the enemy is a human-type, their speed is decreased by 15% for 5 seconds.

Changed (stats are based on sLv. 1)

◇ Sub - Wild Blood
      Increase damage dealt to all enemies by 15%
◇ Main - Weretiger's Roar
      Passive: When performing a basic melee attack, has a 15% chance to increase the duration of 1 buff by 1 second
      Active: Roar loudly and deal 440% damage to surrounding enemies, making them groggy. If the enemy is a human-type, their speed is decreased by 30% for 5 seconds.


* The supporter "[UR] Torajiro" had been favored by many Commanders due to her remarkable utility. However, we adjusted some of her skills because she had been more effective than she was designed to be.


2. Defense Stats

The DEF stats will have changes as follows.

1. Revised the formula that modifies defense(DEF) stats to damage reduction rate.
2. Revised the way how the "Upgrade DEF" is applied.
3. Changed the maximum number of increased DEF from the "Upgrade DEF". (Before: 20% → Changed: 50% / based on Level 25.)
4. Applied the maximum limit to the damage reduction rate.


* To ease the unsatisfactory gameplay experience during combats, especially in the Battle Arena, because characters can't deal damage when the opponent has reached more than a certain DEF stat, we have adjusted some formulas and numbers related to defense stats.
  We will watch what changes the adjustments will bring, and do our best to provide a better gameplay experience.

Thank you.

- Playing the game using abnormal methods such as using speed-boosting programs.

The devs are aware of these issues and are making every effort to resolve them as quickly as possible.

Please be aware that playing the game using abnormal programs is subject to sanctions according to our policies, and we kindly ask for your cooperation in using the game normally.

Especially regarding acts confirmed as abnormal playtime in the Battle Arena and similar modes, we are monitoring user logs and sanctioning users accordingly. We kindly ask for your attention when playing the game.

Furthermore, through improvements in combat mechanics, we plan to fundamentally address these issues to prevent similar occurrences. Depending on the improvement methods and scope, we are also considering providing compensation to all commanders accordingly. We will do our best to implement these improvements as soon as possible.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused during your service usage.

Thank you.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Known Issue: Purchasing Special Pass more than once (Resolved)
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders.

We have identified the following issue after the update on October 24th, 2023.

- Special Pass which is already purchased is available for purchase again.

The Special Pass that was purchasable is the same Special Pass as the one that began on October 4th. The issue occurred whilst applying the purchase period extension for Special Pass due to transaction errors on the Google Playstore from October 11th to Ocotober 16th.

Commanders who purchased the Special Pass again even though they have already purchased October's Special Pass, please contact our customer support (support@gremorygames.com) including your User ID and receipts and we will resolve the problem promptly.
* Google Playstore: Receipts that include Google order number. (Starts with GPA.)
* Apple Appstore: Receipts already processed and given a transaction ID. (Pending receipts are not eligible)
* Steam: Receipts that include Steam order number. (Consists only of numbers)

We apologize for any confusion we may have caused.

Thank you

notes.content:
Greetings Commanders. Thank you for playing Action Taimanin.
We would like to inform you about the updates made to the in-game store, designed to enhance your experience and help you stay cool during the hot summer season.


① Introducing "Amane's Discount Threat", a special discount page just for July.

A special page where you can find all the discounted items will be added. You can check special offers for packages on this page.

※ Special Offers Available For: Hebi-Shika's Helping Hands (30 days), July's Special Pass, Steel Witch Package (Standard)
※ Hebi-Shika's Helping Hands (Special Offer) will be granted as a different item, and you can purchase the package regardless of the remaining period of your current one.
※ Hebi-Shika's Helping Hands (Special Offer) is activated only when using the item you receive upon purchasing the package.


② July Early Access! Meet the "Summer Costume Buffet" package where you can acquire limited costumes at a special price!

A special package where you can acquire 3 limited-time, swimsuit costumes will be released.

※ Costumes included in the respective package.
- Summer Costume Buffet 1: Glowing Pearl (Sakura), Undying Flower (Murasaki), Summer Whirlwind (Kurenai)
- Summer Costume Buffet 2: Beach Side Kitty (Yukikaze), Phantom by the Beach (Shiranui), Beachside Knight (Ingrid)
- Summer Costume Buffet 3: Hunter on Vacation (Rinko), Beach Melon (Su), Hottest Blizzard (Kirara)

※ The costumes will be available for Gems in the store a week after the packages' release.


③ A brand-new limited package "Task Force 101 Package" will be released.

The "Task Force 101 Package" consists of four packages. You can purchase the second package if you acquire the first package, which is available for free. 
The packages include "Task Force Document", "Voucher: Ultimate Weapon", "Voucher: Pickup Supporter" and other generous items, and they are available at a reasonable price!

※ Special Rewards included in each package:

- Step 1: "Hebi-Shika's Day Off (1 Day)" x1
- Step 2: "Task Force Document" x1, Hebi-Shika's Day Off (3 Days) x1
- Step 3: "Voucher: Ultimate Weapon" x1, "Ticket: Limited Weapon & Supporter" x1
- Step 4: "Voucher: Pickup Supporter" x1, "Ticket: Limited Weapon & Supporter" x1


④ Changes and new packages for the Weekly & Monthly Packages

Starting in July, there will be new packages as well as changes made to Weekly & Monthly Packages.
First of all, free Weekly & Monthly Packages will be added. Check the in-game store every week, or month, and claim free rewards including gems, Operational Plan, and Gold.

The details and price of the Weekly Gacha Package will change. And the "Weekly Enchant Package" where you can acquire materials for Enchantment, such as "Orb Kit (UR)", and "Element Kit (UR)" will be added.

The details and price of the Monthly Supporter/Weapon Upgrade Package and Monthly Awakening Package will change. Plus, a "Monthly Magatama & Gold Package" where you can acquire "Voucher: UR Magatama", "Bead (UR)", and "Magatama Gacha Ticket" will be added.

notes.title: A preview of improvements in January
notes.content:
Introducing what will be improved with the update on Jan. 3rd, 2023.


1. Improvements in Affinity effects of the playable characters

The way Affinity effects are applied will be improved.
Now you won't have to set characters in the lobby for the effects to activate. The effects can now be activated from the commander info screen where you can set the supporter formation.
Choose the characters you want in the lobby!


2. Improvements in Selling / Dismantling items

When selling or dismantling items, you will now be able to view them according to their rarity and choose up to 50 items at a time.
Also, the days when you weren't able to dismantle items because your inventory was full are now in the past.


3. Improvements in matchmaking in the Battle Arena

The matchmaking system of the Battle Arena will be improved.
A lot more is now taken into account when matchmaking, so that the matchmaking experience of the Top-Class players, except for the Top 100 players, can be improved.


4. Improvements in the Random Shop's item information

The UI of the VR Shop will be improved.
We will add a feature where you can check daily/weekly/monthly items in the Random Shop.
Click the "?" mark at the bottom left of the Random Shop screen and check daily/weekly/monthly items along with permanent items which you can purchase without limitations.
※ Monthly items cannot be checked for the time being since there aren't any monthly restricted items in the VR Shop at the moment.


5. Improvements in the Rotation Gacha

We will improve the information on the Rotation Gacha.
From Jan. 3rd, characters that share a weapon will also appear in the information.

notes.title: Introducing our new content, Taima-Five VR
notes.content:
A raid quest "Taima-Five VR" officially launches on Dec. 6th, 2022.
Clear the raid quests and acquire various materials including UR magatamas.
You can also get VR points from the quests with which you can exchange rewards in the VR Shop and Random Shop!
※ Taima-Five VR is available for all the users who have cleared main chapter 18 (Easy).


◇ Combat
Taima-Five VR's difficulty increases in steps, depending on your clear time of the current step, from 1 to 3. The default raid screen is set to the highest difficulty available for entry, but you can also choose which step you want to enter.
※ Three characters must be selected to play Taima-Five VR, otherwise you cannot play.
※ The further you progress, the higher the item drop rate becomes. 

BP is used when entering, where bosses with random monster effects await you. You can strengthen your team before entering the stage by using the "Attack Codex", and "Health Codex".
※ More bosses will be added in future updates.

Three playable characters must be selected to play. You will only be controlling one of the characters, and the other two will be controlled by AI. The automatic use of the AI-controlled characters' supporter skills, weapon skills, and Ultimate can be selected from the raid screen.
You can switch your main character (the one you will control) with the two AI-controlled characters. The characters' HP will NOT be restored even after combat, so you have to use "Health Potion" to do that.
※ The characters' HP is restored at 15:00 (UTC) every day.

After clearing a stage, you can acquire various items such as VR Points, materials for evolving magatamas, crystal fragments, and Crystal (Mirage).
※ The amount of VR Points you can acquire a day is limited, and this is reset at 15:00 (UTC) every day. The amount of VR Points you've earned a day is shown on the main screen of Taima-Five VR.


◇ Shop
You can purchase items in the VR Shop and Random Shop with VR Points.
The VR Shop is always available. (Except for the ranking collecting time.) In the Random Shop, items change four times a day, but you can also manually change items with Gems. Use the Help button to view the list of items in the Shop.
※ Random Shop's items are renewed at 03:00, 09:00, 15:00, and 21:00 (UTC) every day.
※ Random Shop limited items: VR weapons, magatama evolving items, UR magatamas, etc.
※ Some items have a limited number of purchases during a certain amount of time. Please below for the detail.
    - Daily reset items: Crystal Fragment, UR Magatamas (All four types), Magatama Polishing Tool (All four types / VR Point available), Ritual Bell, Cutting Fluid, Element Kit (UR), Orb Kit (UR), Health Potion (S/M/L)
    - Weekly reset items: Crystal Kit, Crystal [Mirage] (Random Shop item), Magatama Polishing Tool (All four tyeps / Gem available), Random VR Weapons
    - Monthly reset item: Crystal [Mirage] (VR Shop item)


◇ Rankings
The rankings of the initial clear record and the fastest clear record are collected.
The progress and rank data are reset every Tuesday, from 02:00 to 03:00 (UTC). Personal best records are not reset.

The supporters will be applied correctly through the above steps.

Meanwhile, the abovementioned problem will be fixed during the scheduled maintenance in early October.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Thank you.

Let us introduce the newly improved Package products!
- A Jump-Up package has been added to help your Taimanin evolve faster!
(※ You cannot purchase BOTH the "Character Package" and the "Jump-Up Package", you can only purchase one package out of the two.)
- The starter package, which was a collection of everything you need to promote your Taimanin in the early stages, has been reorganized into three more powerful packages!
- The upgrade rewards of the Commander Jump-Start Package have been reorganized!
- A Weekly & Monthly Package is now available where you can purchase the materials needed to upgrade supporters, weapons and awaken characters!

※  Please understand that due to the change in packages, the "Upgrade Package" and "Commander Jump-Start Package 6" are no longer available.

5. Gacha Improvements
Let us introduce the newly improved Gacha!
Check out the Rotation Gacha, where you can pull different supporters and weapons every day!
※ The rotation gacha is reset every day at 15:00 (UTC), thus the rotation time differs by country.
※ The gacha that hasn’t rotated back yet can be purchased with gems until the gacha has been reset.

6. Improvements in the game and bug fixes
- Corrected the passive skill description of the weapon "Hermetic Megistus" to display the number of supporter set effect enhancements.
- You may now use Gems to proceed character promotion / awakening, supporter awakening, weapon forging, and in the facilities when you lack the required materials.
(※ Certain materials are not purchasable with Gems.)
- After you finish using the facilities, the previous items/character you worked on will remain equipped in the facilities.
- Fixed a bug where the rewards for clearing Chapter 15 in Time Attack aren't displayed correctly.
- Fixed a bug where a part of the next banner is displayed on the current banners.
- Fixed a bug where a crest's HP increasing options are not displayed correctly.
- Fixed a bug where the number of materials are not displayed correctly when resetting the crests.
- Fixed a bug where the Awaken Points are not displayed correctly after acquiring Awaken Skills.

- Fixed a bug in the Arena Tower where the stage will automatically be cleared under certain circumstances.


Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] November 17th Maintenance Complete.
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders,
The maintenance for 2020 Nov. 17th is complete.


[b]1. New Main Quest![/b]

The task force is on the hunt for the source of the zombies that attacked
Gosha Academy. They return to Kotrara Island, the island paradise
which is now a living hell infested with hordes of zombies.
During their search in the underground tunnels of the contaminated island,
the task force comes face to face with an unknown being......

Chapter 7 "Descent into Darkness" is now available!
The story of Action Taimanin continues!


[b]2. Recruit Mizuki Shiranui with Gems![/b]

Recruit "Mizuki Shiranui" with your gems as your new playable character!
※ Price: 1,000 Gems


[b]3. Game Fixes[/b]

- Fixed error on the Steam version where characters won't attack in the Battle Arenas when a user's
Windows is set to certain languages.
- Fixed error on the Steam version where the mouse cursor disappears after character uses their
ultimate in the Battle Arena.


Stay tuned for more exciting news!

notes.title: Notice on Cheats and Abuses
notes.content:
Notice from Action Taimanin admins:

We have identified several users attempting to cheat and/or abuse the game.
In accordance with the Terms of Service, Action Taimanin strictly prohibits cheating and abusing through any means (under "6. User Conduct"), and any users who have violated the terms will have their accounts suspended without prior notice(under "9. Termination").

We are looking into this matter seriously, and will be taking additional measures against cheats and abuses that disrupt fair gameplay.

Best regards,
Action Taimanin Support.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] November 3rd Maintenance Complete
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders, 
The maintenance for Nov. 3rd is complete.
 

[b]1. The Phantom enters with grace![/b]

Pick Up gacha with increased drop rates for Shiranui exclusive weapons are open! 
Roll the gacha a certain number of times and receive a voucher to obtain a UR weapon and an exclusive costume!

※ Pick Up Gacha until 2020, Nov 24th 01:59 (UTC)
※ Pick Up Gacha Rewards: UR Weapon Voucher, Shiranui Costume "Phantom Bride"

 
[b]2. Battle Arena is open! [/b]

Pit your forces against others and battle for the apex spot in the Arena! 
Challenge others in an automatic PVP match for the top rankings! 
Weekly rewards will be given accordingly to your Arena rank! 
Also, collect Arena coins and exchange them for various items!
 
※ To unlock the Battle Arena, you must clear the Prologue Stages and collect data. 
To collect data, you can repeat the same stage, or play the stage with multiplied AP points.


[b]3. Golden Pass open![/b]

Receive various prizes just by clearing many missions! 
Purchase the Special Pass to receive additional + exclusive rewards!
 
※ Exclusive Pass Prize: Costume Voucher: New Year, Yukikaze’s Costume “Pistols of Fury” 
※ Pass purchasable until 2020, Nov. 24th 01:59 (UTC) 


[b]4. Game fixes![/b]

- Fixed error on Steam version where the UI disappears when pressing Esc button during Main Quests. 
- Fixed error of recovered AP points not being applied properly when commander rank increases. 


Stay tuned for more!
